title: Doc-to-LoRA Analysis: Query Conditioning, Wrong Facts, and Distractor Interference
abstract: arXiv:2611.30825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Doc-to-LoRA (D2L) compiles documents into low-rank adapters, allowing language models to use their contents without repeatedly processing the original text. We investigate its suitability for internalizing user memories through factual question answering, controlled interventions, and a production MidBrain memory pipeline. Across Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-4B, D2L loses accuracy relative to in-context learning, with additional documents introducing substantial interference. Single-document errors frequently match answers to other questions about the same passage, suggesting unreliable question-answer attribution. Layer-wise interventions show that interference accumulates across depth, with more concentrated early damage at larger bank sizes on Gemma. With eight documents, applying the full bank in the initial layers gives similar accuracy to withholding all document contributions there. Source membership is detectable in intermediate states,

translated_title: Doc-to-LoRA 分析：查询条件化、错误事实与干扰项干扰
translated_abstract: Doc-to-LoRA（D2L）将文档编译为低秩适配器，使语言模型无需反复处理原始文本即可利用其内容。我们通过事实性问答、受控干预实验以及一个生产环境中的 MidBrain 记忆流水线，研究其在内化用户记忆方面的适用性。在 Gemma-2-2B 和 Qwen3-4B 两个模型上，D2L 相比上下文学习出现了准确率损失，且额外的文档会引入显著的干扰。单文档场景下的错误常常表现为把答案与同一段落的其他问题相匹配，表明问题-答案归因不可靠。逐层干预实验显示，干扰会随网络深度不断累积，在 Gemma 上，当文档库规模更大时，早期层的损伤更为集中。在有八个文档的情况下，在初始层应用完整文档库所得到的准确率，与在这些层完全屏蔽所有文档贡献的准确率相近。文档来源归属信息在中间层状态中是可以被检测到的。
tldr: 该论文通过事实问答、受控干预和生产级记忆流水线系统分析了 Doc-to-LoRA 方法，发现其在内化用户记忆时相比上下文学习准确率下降，多文档间干扰随层数累积、问答归因不可靠，揭示了文档编译适配器在记忆内化上的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically analyzes Doc-to-LoRA for internalizing user memories, showing that it loses accuracy relative to in-context learning, suffers from unreliable question-answer attribution, and accumulates cross-document interference across layers, exposing key limitations of compiling documents into low-rank adapters.
